title: Task
description: Generic task envelope shared by every task type (research, prototype, domain, architecture, specification, review, decomposition, implementation, verification, retrospective, child-mission). Spec §6.1. Normative examples: spec §6.1 implementation task (ACCOUNT-12) and research task (PROJECT-RESEARCH-3).

id.description: Task id, unique within its mission (spec §6.1).

workflow.description: Pinned workflow binding plus the originating stage id (spec §6.1).

step.description: Workflow stage id this task instantiates.

type.description: Task type (spec §6.1). The scheduler handles the generic envelope; the bound role contract validates the type-specific payload.

role.description: Role contract id bound to this task, e.g. 'worker' (spec §6.1, Appendix F).

dependencies.description: Task ids this task depends on (spec §6.1).

inputs.description: Task inputs by typed URI (spec §6.1 Artifact references). Non-ephemeral URIs are pinned to a version or hash at workflow instantiation; ephemeral references (e.g. question://) may appear as a bare URI string with content carried in payload instead.

outputs.description: Output artifact names/URIs this task must produce (spec §6.1).

budget.description: Attempt and dollar budget for this task (spec §6.1). Exceeding budget.attempts moves the task to BLOCKED with reason budget-exhausted (DESIGN.md §6).

payload.description: Type-specific payload. Strictly shaped for implementation tasks (spec §6.1); open-ended object for all other task types, since each role contract in Appendix F defines and validates its own payload shape.

status.description: Task lifecycle status (spec §6.3, DESIGN.md §3). Generic lifecycle: BLOCKED, READY, ASSIGNED, RUNNING, GATING, REPAIR, DONE. Implementation specialization replaces GATING/DONE with VERIFYING, REVIEWING, MERGE_READY, MERGED, DEPLOYED, PRODUCTION_VERIFIED (an implementation task is DONE at MERGED; DEPLOYED/PRODUCTION_VERIFIED never block dependents).

blocked_reason.description: Machine reason code set when status is BLOCKED, e.g. 'budget-exhausted' (DESIGN.md §6). Optional runtime field.

lease.description: Runtime lease held by the executing agent, or null when unclaimed (DESIGN.md §3, spec §6.3). Optional runtime field maintained by the CLI.

attempt.description: Current attempt count, bounded by budget.attempts (spec §6.3). Optional runtime field maintained by the CLI.

taskInputRef.description: Either a bare typed URI (ephemeral references such as question://, or a template-time unpinned reference) or an object pinning the URI to a version or content hash (spec §6.1 Artifact references / Pinning).

implementationPayload.description: Implementation task payload shape (spec §6.1, ACCOUNT-12 example).

areas.description: Codebase areas touched, e.g. java-api, auth.

design.description: Pinned design decisions the worker implements but does not silently replace (spec §5.1, §6.1).

verification.description: Required verification checks, e.g. unit, integration, api-runtime (spec §6.1, §9).
